role: number of edges of G with an end in N and both ends in S union N
notes: Auxiliary count introduced for the proofs; equals the parameter e of the rooted graph (S,G[S u N]) when S is finite. Not Spencer's notation. sec:p03-w03-p03-064-closure writes the same count as e_G(S,Y).

role: t-closure of a vertex set or tuple (least t-closed superset)
notes: Spencer's notation cl_t (author's version p. 8, set in italic there); also \(\mathrm{cl}_t\) in def:p03-w03-p03-067-sparse-notions and italic cl_t in sec:p03-w03-p03-064-closure.

role: closure of a tuple isomorphic to a rooted closure type
notes: Spencer's notation (author's version pp. 8-9); roots in positions given by rho.

role: first-order formula defining a t-closure type
notes: Local name for the formula whose existence Spencer asserts (author's version p. 9); sec:p03-w03-p03-064-closure names its formula theta_{t,H}.

role: limit probability of sentence A in G(n n^{-alpha}) as a function of irrational alpha
notes: Spencer's notation (author's version p. 15); same symbol in def:p03-w03-p03-069-spectrum.

role: almost sure theory of G(n n^{-alpha})
notes: Spencer's notation (author's version pp. 9-10 and 15); also used in sec:p03-w03-p03-065-sparse-regime and def:p03-w03-p03-067-sparse-notions.

role: spectrum: rational points of discontinuity of f_A
notes: Spencer's notation Sp(A) (author's version p. 15); same spelling as def:p03-w03-p03-069-spectrum.

role: rooted graph whose extension statement switches at the rational q
